decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already shows a strong quantified customer result (over 600,000 euros saved per year), so the option is moving into the money and fits the firm's modular strategic direction.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has its own dedicated page, so it is cheap to carry, and its uncertainty is still resolving in a growing market.
As the flagship modular product line, its value is still uncertain but strategically central, so keeping the option open is worth far more than its carrying cost.
The trommel screen is close to the established business and costs little to keep on the market, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
